items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: I had a young lady to play piano with me. Her name was Beryl Booker... I had a quartet at that particular time with Johnny Collins on the guitar and Harold West on the drums

ctx.x: Well, do you remember which times those were, when you had to work the hardest at getting along with the guys and making the music work?

Well, I would -- let's see if I can remember. One time, after Billy Taylor was with me for a while on piano, after Billy left, I had a young lady to play piano with me. Her name was Beryl Booker and of course, let's see, I had a quartet at that particular time with Johnny Collins on the guitar and Harold West on the drums and of course, there were times when we -- there were little situations where they used to argue amongst themselves, you know, and I tried to get them straight, cool things and what have you.…
That was one of the times when I'd rather not have been a leader, you know.
